json.justification: The electric meter (Photo 11) has open, unobstructed siding to its side for the Disco with a clear conduit path down to grade. Following that wall around the corner (Photos 12-15) there is a long clear stretch of mulch/rock-lined foundation past the ground-floor windows, with no driveway, pool, or window well nearby and normal roofline overhead clearance - giving a valid battery spot more than 3 ft from any opening and 5+ ft from the distant gas meter/pipes seen in Photos 1-4. No door or garage lies between the meter and this spot, so the harness run is feasible.
